hypotheses.I0_native_path_is_exact: Native replacement reproduces independent logits within maximum absolute error 0.02.
hypotheses.I1_novel_axes_add_finite_logit_coverage: Adding the rank-two novel complement improves finite full-logit fidelity over semantic-plus-generic rank four in at least three layers and by at least 0.02 on average.
hypotheses.I2_novel_axes_add_prediction_relevant_co: Adding the novel complement improves signed per-example CE-effect fidelity in at least three layers and by at least 0.02 on average.
hypotheses.I3_novel_axes_beat_equal_rank_random_com: Mean novel-complement full-logit improvement exceeds every one of 32 frozen random orthogonal-complement improvements.
hypotheses.I4_ce_selected_rank4_is_a_strong_compact: Semantic modes plus the CE-selected residual rank-four basis achieve mean finite logit fidelity at least 0.80.
